eligibility_reason: Original CSI1 Table 1 findings are valid reproduction targets independently of improvement, and 20 printed method/category accuracies are verified. Complete native query/payload identity, publication scoring/checkpoint provenance, original baseline pipelines, required control values, justified equivalence criteria and immutable execution verification remain unresolved. The reviewed source scorer is a bounded declared-trace component, not an executed reproduction.

evidence.locator: Sections 4 and 5.1; complete CSI1/BOLD5000-QA half of Table 1; Appendix F.2, G.1-G.3
evidence.supports: Five original CSI1 comparison methods and all four reported accuracies; original data/task, preprocessing, training and generated-answer baseline parser descriptions.
Subject/split directory loading, per-record queries/answers and full-record return.
Train/test domain construction, query exclusion, training sampling, test-based checkpoint selection; source flags must be authenticated.
Existing CSI1 metadata inventory (4802 train/84 test paths), prospective exhaustive scorer and explicitly unqualified status.
Source posthoc unseen-concept and TF-only hop exclusions; caught exceptions; TF non-yes coercion; exact vocabulary accuracy and QA-weighted combined score.
Structured answer decoding and null-execution failure numerator/denominator; monitor count weighting.
Three ordered built-ins and potentially partial parser-returned domain; exact original concept eligibility must be recovered.

evidence.locator: Complete Movement, Position, Thing and YesNo mapping
evidence.supports: Source vocabulary category membership; Thing and unclassified successful vocabulary calls must not disappear from the overall denominator.

evidence.locator: Pinned CSI1/train and CSI1/test path inventory; 4802 train and 84 test paths retained in historical registration
evidence.supports: Path inventory and original split route only; no native payload, stimulus identity or complete 2,095-query census authentication.

evidence.locator: inspect_manifest, score, compare and main; source_score.py raw SHA-256 c4d1d07bb20e58e4bdf6b2b36f01a87c419b5b96a9077803a15bba50dfe643ca
evidence.supports: Reviewed executable single-trace source scoring and denominator ledger; generated tests only, no publication-native run or full control-suite delivery.

target.description: Answer semantic queries about the viewed image from CSI1 fMRI: action, position and true/false answers, using the original BOLD5000-QA task in Table 1. This is not visual reconstruction or a new cross-subject task.

dataset.description: Author BOLD5000-QA, derived from BOLD5000 images and image-aligned fMRI. Section 4 reports 133146 training and 2095 test QA examples; the source loader consumes the author subject/train and subject/test NPY directories. Payload identity and manifest reconciliation remain admission blockers.

cohort.description: CSI1 is the subject for Table 1 BOLD5000-QA and the registered component. Appendix four-subject mean 0.7102 and CNeuroMod results are different paper endpoints; neither may be substituted as this baseline or claimed from a CSI1 win.

split.description: Retain the original image-aligned train/test partition referenced in Appendix F.2 and the released CSI1 directories. Filenames are not validated stimulus IDs. Exact image aliases, eligible query denominator, selected checkpoint and exposure history remain unresolved. A new split or train-only denominator cannot count against Table 1.

inputs.description: A symbolic question and the corresponding fMRI tensor; model output is a Boolean or answer-vocabulary concept. Images, scene graphs and answers used to construct QA are not inference inputs. Author source uses train+test query strings for symbolic-domain construction, which must be explicitly reconciled with the evaluation access policy.

preprocessing.description: Appendix F.2: WAVE-preprocessed image-aligned BOLD5000 fMRI, five TRs by 1024 regions, 2-second TR and a two-TR hemodynamic lag. Preserve the published atlas/model configuration; a different atlas is a separate paper condition.

metric.description: Overall structured-answer QA accuracy, proportion of correct evaluated queries, with action/position/T/F companions. Exact original inclusion and decoding aggregation must match Table 1: training source can skip test queries with unseen concepts, whereas the local evaluator includes all declared queries and failures.

aggregation.description: Table 1 is within CSI1 QA-level overall accuracy, alongside category accuracies, not an equal-image or four-subject average. Image/person summaries and neural-input controls are additional diagnostics.

full_panel.description: The registered original panel is CSI1/BOLD5000-QA Table 1: Linear, UMBRAE, SDRecon, BrainCap and NEURONA, each with Overall, Action, Position and T/F accuracy on the publication-identical query population. Retain all 20 printed method/metric findings, source training-monitor versus final-posthoc denominator accounting, the full Movement/Position/Thing/YesNo/unknown query-category ledger, and every exclusion/failure. Required benchmark companions additionally retain matched neural, no-neural and shuffled-neural conditions and a separately trained text-only comparator; these controls have no verified published numeric targets. Apply the same full panel under paper_data and paper_data_author_code, adding only author code. The 84 test paths and 2095 stated questions are different identities; the complete per-record source query roster, original baselines and native control execution are not authenticated. Table 2 unseen-query, CNeuroMod and four-subject findings are separate endpoints and are not substituted for this registered CSI1 task.

permitted_observations.description: Inference observes the original symbolic query and aligned5 TR by 1024-region CSI1 fMRI under the original atlas/transform. Original training labels are training resources; test answers, viewed images, scene graphs, stimulus identities and construction metadata are operator-held and not inference inputs. The author domain uses train+test query programs and historical best-test checkpoint selection; authentic access/selection histories must be reconciled explicitly, never silently replaced by the prospective train-only exhaustive protocol. Match original scientific inputs and budgets across paper_data and paper_data_author_code with author code as the only information addition. Match non-neural resources within neural/no-neural/shuffled-neural controls, keep neural donors outside control participants, and distinguish zero-input inference from a separately trained text-only model. Native payload delivery, code bundle and participant isolation remain unverified.
